recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12752 unless OO separately chooses to do a broader editorial review of ServiceRequest v2 mappings.
issue_request: FHIR-12752 was a Published FHIR-core/OO change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to review ReferralRequest.type and ReferralRequest.reason because the DSTU2 v2 mapping page showed both mapped to RF1-10, and the final resolution was to restore past ReferralRequest and ProcedureRequest v2 mappings into the merged current request resource and correct RF1-10.
initial_application: Git commit 0a7ed16569acf4bb506e0ae1b1c2aa549e6eab91, 'GF#12752 added V2 mappings', appears to have applied the issue on 2017-10-18 by updating the ServiceRequest spreadsheet source after the request-resource merge. It added RF1-5 for the ReferralRequest.type lineage represented by ServiceRequest.category and ORC.16/RF1-10 for ServiceRequest.reason; later source refactors carried those mappings into structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml.
additional_context: The current build no longer has active ProcedureRequest or ReferralRequest resources. source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as active and records ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest and ReferralRequest as becoming ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest source maps category to RF1-5 and reason to ORC-16, RF1-10, and bounded Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later final decision that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active current source already reflects the corrected v2 mapping distinction requested by FHIR-12752.
